test_title: PYST 7: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, each has scored different marks in the first semester examination. Only two people scored more than Q. P scored more than Q but less than O. M scored more than R but less than S. Only 3 students scored more than S. N scored the least among all. The scores of how many students are between the scores of P and R?
solution:
*__**Seven friends:**__* M, N, O, P, Q, R and S.

1) Only two people scored more than Q.

**_ > _ > Q > _ > _ > _ > _**

2) P scored more than Q but less than O.

**O > P > Q**

3) M scored more than R but less than S.

**S > M > R**

4) Only 3 students scored more than S.

**_ > _ > _ > S > _ > _ > _**

5) N scored the least among all. 

**_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > _ > N**

Combining all the statements:

O > P > Q > S > M > R > N

Three students are between the scores of P and R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
